# Municipal Ordinance No. 003, Series of 2009

**Water Quality Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance mandates regular water sampling and laboratory analysis for all water refilling stations, delivery tankers, and deep wells within the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] to ensure the distribution of safe and potable water. It outlines the responsibilities of various stakeholders, including the [[Municipal Health Office]] and barangay officials, in monitoring and enforcing water quality standards. Penalties are specified for non-compliance.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Title: This ordinance shall be known and cited as the Regulatory Ordinance to Ensure the Distribution of Safe and Potable Water in the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
2.  **Section 2.** Definitions of Terms:
    *   2.1 Potable Water - water that is suitable for drinking.
    *   2.2 Infraction - referred to in this ordinance as offense or violation.
3.  **Section 3.** Coverage: This ordinance shall apply to water refilling stations, and water delivery tankers, deep wells and other sources that supply drinking water to different barangays in the municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
4.  **Section 4.** All water refilling stations and water delivery tankers and water dispensing outlets are required to submit to the [[Municipal Health Office]] certificate of water analysis and certificate of potability from the provincial laboratory on monthly basis.
5.  **Section 5.** All sources of water in poblacion and barangays such as deep wells, and water tanks shall also be included in the periodic testing and analysis of water samples, that is, once in every three (3) months as provided for by the Philippine National Standards for Drinking Water.
6.  **Section 6.** The [[Municipal Health Office]] is tasked to submit all water samples to the Provincial Laboratory for analysis on a regular basis.
7.  **Section 7.** Submission of water samples from public deep wells and water tank shall be the responsibility of the barangay officials or in particular the barangay committee chairman on health. This shall likewise be done once in every three (3) months.
8.  **Section 8.** The [[Municipal Health Office]] is empowered/tasked to conduct periodic or on the spot inspections/checks on the facilities of water refilling stations including water delivery tankers in the municipality and secure therefrom water sample for laboratory analysis at any reasonable hour of the day.
9.  **Section 9.** Payment of laboratory analysis fee shall be shouldered by the refilling stations and delivery tankers. In the case of barangay deep wells and tanks, payment shall be shouldered by the barangay itself.
10. **Section 10.** The Municipal Health Office, subject to the approval of Municipal Mayor and/or [[Sangguniang Bayan]] may promulgate additional rules and regulations as may be deemed necessary for the effective implementation of this ordinance.
11. **Section 11.** The [[Municipal Health Office]] thru the Sanitary Inspector and with the assistance of Philippine National Police (PNP) shall also be in charge of monitoring the compliance of water refilling stations and delivery tankers and the enforcement of this ordinance.
12. **Section 12.** Failure and/or refusal on the part of the water refilling stations and water delivery tankers to provide/submit water samples required herein or should there be unfavorable analysis result thereon, said water refillers and water delivery tankers shall be subjected to the following penalties, to wit;
    *   12. A first infraction - temporary cancellation of operation of the facilities until favorable result of water sample analysis is obtained.
    *   12. B second infraction - =P= 2,000.00
    *   12. C third infraction - =P= 2,500.00 and cancellation of business license/permit
    *   All sources of water in poblacion and brgys. such as deep wells and tanks which yielded unfavorable result upon laboratory analysis/testing shall be declared/labeled as unfit for consumption and shall not be subjected to penalties as stated above.
13. **Section 13.** Repealing Clause. All ordinances, rules and regulations inconsistent or in conflict with the provisions of this ordinance are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
14. **Section 14.** Effectivity. This Ordinance shall take effect upon approval of the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] and 15 days following the public dissemination and information.
